description: TPC-H decision-support benchmark at scale factor 0.01: regions, nations, customers, suppliers, parts, orders, line items (8 CSVs, ~87k rows). Several questions are natural-language versions of official TPC-H queries.
source: Generated with DuckDB's tpch extension: CALL dbgen(sf = 0.01)
license: TPC-H specification data generator (free to use for benchmarking/evaluation)

questions.question: How many orders were placed in 1995?
questions.gold_sql: SELECT count(*) AS orders FROM orders WHERE year(o_orderdate) = 1995

questions.question: How many customers are in each market segment?
questions.gold_sql: SELECT c_mktsegment AS segment, count(*) AS customers FROM customer GROUP BY segment ORDER BY customers DESC, segment

questions.question: Show total revenue per year.
questions.gold_sql: SELECT year(o.o_orderdate) AS year, round(sum(l.l_extendedprice * (1 - l.l_discount)), 2) AS revenue FROM lineitem l JOIN orders o ON o.o_orderkey = l.l_orderkey GROUP BY year ORDER BY year

questions.question: What is the revenue by region?
questions.gold_sql: SELECT r.r_name AS region, round(sum(l.l_extendedprice * (1 - l.l_discount)), 2) AS revenue FROM lineitem l JOIN orders o ON o.o_orderkey = l.l_orderkey JOIN customer c ON c.c_custkey = o.o_custkey JOIN nation n ON n.n_nationkey = c.c_nationkey JOIN region r ON r.r_regionkey = n.n_regionkey GROUP BY region ORDER BY revenue DESC
questions.notes: Region is reached via the customer's nation.

questions.question: Which 5 nations had the most revenue from local suppliers in Asia during 1994?
questions.gold_sql: SELECT n.n_name AS nation, round(sum(l.l_extendedprice * (1 - l.l_discount)), 2) AS revenue FROM customer c JOIN orders o ON c.c_custkey = o.o_custkey JOIN lineitem l ON l.l_orderkey = o.o_orderkey JOIN supplier s ON l.l_suppkey = s.s_suppkey AND c.c_nationkey = s.s_nationkey JOIN nation n ON s.s_nationkey = n.n_nationkey JOIN region r ON n.n_regionkey = r.r_regionkey WHERE r.r_name = 'ASIA' AND o.o_orderdate >= DATE '1994-01-01' AND o.o_orderdate < DATE '1995-01-01' GROUP BY nation ORDER BY revenue DESC LIMIT 5

questions.question: Summarize quantity, price and average discount of line items shipped on or before 1998-09-02, grouped by return flag and line status.
questions.gold_sql: SELECT l_returnflag, l_linestatus, sum(l_quantity) AS sum_qty, round(sum(l_extendedprice), 2) AS sum_base_price, round(sum(l_extendedprice * (1 - l_discount)), 2) AS sum_disc_price, round(avg(l_discount), 4) AS avg_disc, count(*) AS count_order FROM lineitem WHERE l_shipdate <= DATE '1998-09-02' GROUP BY l_returnflag, l_linestatus ORDER BY l_returnflag, l_linestatus

questions.question: Who are the top 10 customers by total order value?
questions.gold_sql: SELECT c.c_name AS customer, round(sum(o.o_totalprice), 2) AS total_order_value FROM customer c JOIN orders o ON o.o_custkey = c.c_custkey GROUP BY customer ORDER BY total_order_value DESC LIMIT 10

questions.question: What percentage of line items were shipped later than their commit date?
questions.gold_sql: SELECT round(100.0 * count(*) FILTER (WHERE l_receiptdate > l_commitdate) / count(*), 2) AS late_pct FROM lineitem
questions.notes: 'Shipped late' is interpreted as received after the committed date.

questions.question: Break that down by ship mode.
questions.gold_sql: SELECT l_shipmode AS ship_mode, round(100.0 * count(*) FILTER (WHERE l_receiptdate > l_commitdate) / count(*), 2) AS late_pct FROM lineitem GROUP BY ship_mode ORDER BY late_pct DESC

questions.question: How many customers have never placed an order?
questions.gold_sql: SELECT count(*) AS customers_without_orders FROM customer c WHERE NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM orders o WHERE o.o_custkey = c.c_custkey)

questions.question: What is the average order total?
questions.gold_sql: SELECT round(avg(o_totalprice), 2) AS avg_order_total FROM orders
questions.notes: Joining orders to lineitem before averaging o_totalprice weights orders by their line count.

questions.question: Which suppliers are the most profitable?
questions.notes: Profit needs a definition (revenue minus ps_supplycost * quantity?) and a time range; assistant should state assumptions or ask.

questions.question: What was the customer satisfaction score per region?
questions.notes: No satisfaction or rating data exists.
